title: Funko Pop! Animation Bleach Uryu Ishida #1696 Vinyl Figure New in Box
descriptionText:
Funko Pop! Animation - Bleach - Uryu Ishida #1696 vinyl figure, new and unopened in the original box. Uryu in his white Quincy uniform with his bow drawn.

This is the standard common release, not the glow-in-the-dark chase.

Condition: New, never opened - the figure has not been removed from the box. The box is clean and square with light shelf wear; the plastic window has a crease and a small scuff near the top (shown in the close-up photos). Please review all photos - they are of the actual item you will receive. Ships bubble wrapped in a box.
